senses.gloss:
r. 3rd cl. (तुतोर्त्ति)
To go quick, to hurry, to make haste; this root is restricted to the Vedas: see त्वर.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Quick, swift.
E.
तुर to make haste, क aff.

(ई) तूरी r. 4th cl. (तूर्य्यते)
To go quick, to make haste.
2 To kill, to hurt or injure.

n. (-रं)
Any musical instrument.
f. (-री)
A trumpet.
E.
त्वर to speed, affix अच्.

m. (-गः)
1 A horse.
2 The mind.
E.
त्वर speed, velocity, and ग what goes, व changed to उ.
f. (-गी)
1 A plant, (Physalis flexuosa): see अश्वगन्ध.
2 A mare.
E.
ङीष् added to तुरग.

f. (-न्धा)
A plant: see the preceding.
E.
तुरग a horse, and गन्ध small, smelling like a horse; also अश्वगन्ध, &c.

n. (-कं)
Necessary celibacy, leading a life of continence, in consequence merely of being without female society.
E.
तुरग a horse, and ब्रह्मचर्य्यक the practice of a religious student, one of whose duties is continence.

mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि)
Equestrian, riding, mounted or carried on a horse.
m. (-गी)
A horseman, cavalier, &c.
E.
तुरग a horse, and इनि aff.

m. (-ङ्गः)
1 A horse.
2 The mind, considered as the seat of feeling as well as intellect, the heart.
E.
त्वर speedily, and ग what goes.
f. (-ङ्गी)
1 A plant: see तुरगी and तुरगगन्धा.
2 A mare.
E.
ङीष् added to the preceding.

m. (-कः)
A plant, a kind of Ghosha, commonly हस्तिघोष.
E.
तुरङ्ग a horse, and कन् affix of analogy; coursing through the body.

f. (-णी)
A she buffalo.
E.
तुरङ्ग, and द्विषणी disliking.

m. (-यः)
Barley.
E.
तुरङ्ग, and प्रिय fond of.

m. (-मः)
A horse.
E.
त्वर speed, and गम to go, with खच् aff.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
Going on horseback.
E.
तुरङ्ग, and यायिन् who goes.

m. (-क्त्रः)
A Kinnara or quirister of INDRA'S heaven.
E.
तुरङ्ग a horse, and वक्त्र a face.

m. (-नः)
A celestial quirister.
E.
तुरङ्ग a horse, and वदन a face; these beings are described as having the bodies of men, and the heads of horses; also similar compounds, as तुरङ्गानन, तुरङ्गवक्त्र, तुगङ्गास्य, अश्ववक्त्र, &c.

m. (-रिः)
1 A buffalo.
2 Oleander.
E.
तुरङ्ग, and अरि foe.

m. (-ङ्गी)
1 A horseman, a rider.
2 A groom.
E.
तुरङ्ग, and इनि aff.

subst. mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Attachment to any object or pursuit.
adj.
Attached to any object or pursuit.
m. (-णः)
A particular sacrifice.
E.
त्वर speed, haste, अय to go, affix ल्यु; speeding towards a given end or in a certain cause: see परायण.

m. (-षाट् or षाड्)
A name of INDRA.
E.
तुर for त्वर haste, सह to bear, in the causal form, and क्विप् affix, स being changed to ष in inflexion.

f. (-रिः)
See the next; also तुलि.

f. (-री)
1 A brush or a fibrous stick used by weavers to clean and separate the threads of the woof.
2 A painter's brush, &c.: see तुली.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Fourth, a fourth.
m. (-यः)
A fourth part, a quarter.
n. (-यं)
The divine being, or universal spirit.
E.
irr. derived from चतुर् four, with छ affix; also तूर्य्य and तुर्य्य.

m. (-गः)
A fourth part or share.
E.
तुरीय, and भाग share.

mfn. (-भाक्)
A sharer of a fourth.
E.
तुरीय, and भाज who divides.

m. (-र्णः)
The Śūdra or fourth tribe of the Hindus.
E.
तुरीय fourth, and वर्ण tribe.

m. (-शः)
A fourth part, a quarter share.
E.
तुरीय, and अंश a share.

m. (-ष्कः)
1 Incense.
2 A country, or
m. plu. (-ष्काः)
Its inhabitants; Turan or Turkestan, the original country of the Turks.
E.
तुर to haste, (into smoke, &c.) affix उस्, and कन् added.

mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं)
Fourth.
E.
irr. derived from चतुर् four, with यत् aff.

mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं)
Fourth: see तुर्य्य
n. (-र्य्यं)
Any musical instrument, the genus of which four species are reckoned, as wind instruments, stringed instruments, &c.
E.
चतुर four, यत् deriv. irr.

(इ) तुर्वी r. 1st cl. (तुर्वति)
To hurt, to injure, to kill.

m. (-सुः)
One of the sons of YAYĀTI, king of the south and eastern portion of India, reigning over the Mleccha tribes

f. (-तूः)
Speed.
m. (-तूः)
A courier.
E.
त्वर to make haste, क्विप् affix, and the semivowel changed to ऊ.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
Quick, expeditious.
n. adv. (-र्णं)
Quick, swift, quickly.
E.
त्वर to go swiftly, affix क्त.

m. (-र्णिः)
1 Speed, velocity, expedition.
2 Dirt, excrement.
3 A stanza.
4 The mind.
E.
त्वर to make haste, Uṇādi affix नि.

m. (-ण्डः)
A musical instrument, a sort of tabor.
